title: The model pass and the phase 2 spike (generated cover): the reference, the model in Cycles, and the same model live in a widget window (WebGL2, the same studio as a pair of light maps, the light pass)
notes: part: The cover sits on the ridge and looks heavy: a round ring of glass now wraps it on every side and the ridge rolls under its lower edge, in both renders; the ring is still thinner than the reference's.
part: The ridge is one unbroken line from under the cover to the tail: one roll all the way; its highlight breaks at the twist in Cycles and fades under the words live.
ok: The twist and the sheet over the buttons read clearly, in both.
part: The words are clean: no line crosses the title and the glass behind the words is darker; live, a reflection still touches the title's end and runs just behind the artist's.
part: The glass shines: live has broad warm rims, luminous lobes and darker middles, with a few thin strip lines left; Cycles is clearer but greyer.
measured: live at 60 fps on the RTX 3070, the GPU process's 3D engine 1.7% at 1586x992 and 1.3% at 1190x744 (the idle card 4 to 5%); uncapped about 350 fps.
